data.name: Neils
data.short_meaning: A variant of Norweigan Niels, derived from the Germanic name Dietrich, meaning 'ruler of the people'.
data.long_meaning: The name Neils originated from the Old Norse name Njal or Njáll, which means 'champion' or 'strong, generous man'. It evolved into the Scandinavian Niels, and was later adopted in the Germanic-speaking regions. In English, it is believed to mean 'ruler of the people', derived from the Germanic name Dietrich.
